question: Huh? Huuuh?? The Baratie has gotten bigger in chapter 902!!! Is their business expanding? Hooray! I want to tell Sanji-kun! by Chopa
answer: Yep. That's right! In the cover story of chapter 625 the Baratie was in the middle of being renovated and this is its final form! Furthermore, the Meat Master Carne and the Patissier Patty run separate chain restaurants, so there are now 3 "Sea Faring Restaurant Baraties".
name: Chopa
